scope: Read all eight v1 document replies and both workflow-on final learning cards; bounded qualitative review, not complete semantic certification.

findings.status: OPEN：通用提示未解决日志工作流中的扩写
findings.observation: 开启journal-review的首轮仍将“贴图烘焙失败”扩写为“贴图烘焙环节出现异常阻断”；来源没有确认阻断事件。关闭工作流时仅记录失败，未作此扩写。

findings.status: OPEN：关闭工作流有所改善，开启仍遗漏
findings.observation: 关闭工作流的更正明确保留“原定明日排查”并标内容待复核；开启工作流的更正将下一步写为“复核并准备贴图烘焙工作”，未保留明天和原排查动作。

findings.status: OPEN：外部效果表述与建议边界仍含糊
findings.observation: 预算更正关闭工作流写“已废弃归档”，开启工作流写“已做过期标注与追溯留存”，但这里只修改回复，没有真实文件归档回执；开启工作流还把执行项目支出列为下一步，未明确说明是尚未采纳的建议。不能据此证明已发生外部归档或已授权支出。
八份文档中的显式预算、阅读时间、渲染/烘焙状态与当前来源字段相符；文档更正也描述替换。此观察不能掩盖前述计划和措辞缺口。
两份开启工作流的最终学习卡均保留independent_mastery=false、retry_completed=false和delayed_test=null；下一步仍要求完成重试。未取得真实学习者或延迟复测证据。

interpretation: All24 v1 turns passed frozen field checks, but free-prose review still finds issues. Prompt-only repair did not meet the full free-prose objective. V2 source-excerpt success must not substitute for v1 semantic quality.

root_cause_hypothesis.evidence: seed/skills/conversation.json journal-review guidance asks for observations and 1-3 next actions; possible pressure to fill a template and conflate proposed with confirmed plans
root_cause_hypothesis.causal_validation: NOT_TESTED; do not treat skill as proven sole cause

next_change: Integrate a source/current-plan representation and visible correction review using the existing domain/host path; verify free-prose contradictions and reasonable summarization with independent examples before making it an automatic completion gate. Avoid another unmeasured prompt-only success claim.
